B1.body: Antea Group USA has a new Consultant. His name is Jason Ruf. He will support the firm's Environmental Remediation practice. Jason has 27 years of experience. B2.body: Antea Group USA has announced the addition of Jason Ruf as a Consultant. Jason brings over 27 years of experience integrating environmental data, geologic understanding, and advanced visualization tools. He has worked on hundreds of sites worldwide, including brownfield, industrial, and Superfund projects. His work focuses on integrating historic site information, high-density subsurface data, and geologic frameworks to develop robust Conceptual Site Models. This approach provides a stronger framework for supporting remedial design and site closure strategies. Jason's expertise includes 3D Visualization, Conceptual Site Model development, and High-Resolution Site Characterization. His leadership will drive innovation within Antea Group's Environmental Remediation practice, enhancing the firm's ability to translate complex environmental data into actionable insights for clients. Jason's addition to the team is expected to have a significant impact on the firm's ability to support clients in making informed, data-driven decisions.
